sentences: Drawing is one of the major forms of expression within the visual arts.
Drawing is generally concerned with the marking of lines and areas of tone onto paper or other material.
In drawing, the accurate representation of the visual world is expressed upon a plane surface.

In Western terminology, drawing is distinct from painting.

Similar supports can serve both drawing and painting.
Painting generally involves the application of liquid paint onto prepared canvas or panels.
Sometimes an underdrawing is drawn first on the same support that is later painted.
